title: The lab results rules version is a hand-kept Swift constant, not the engine's
evidence: ios/HealthRoadmap/Health/HealthSyncMemory.swift:40 labResultsRulesVersion = 2, read at AppleHealthSync.swift:241; bumped by hand when the engine's lab-result rules change (US-72). Should come from the engine. Found during shared upload PR 1, 2026-11-11
